# ECHO

ECHO is a login-free YouTube karaoke room. One host screen plays the music while guests use their phones as search and queue remotes.

## Entry points

- [Create a room](/): Start a named host room and receive a scannable invitation QR.
- [Join a room](/join): Enter a sixteen-character room code and a display name.
- [Scan a QR](/scan): Use the phone camera to open the room invitation.

## Notes

- Room screens are not public directories and are excluded from crawling in robots.txt.
- YouTube search requires a server-side API key. The app always explains this and offers the paste-link fallback.
- Guest permissions for requests and playback are independent. Skipping, removing and reordering are host-only.
